stem_book: A conical pendulum of length L makes an angle θ with the vertical as shown in figure. The time period will be (a) 2π√(L cosθ/g) (b) 2π√(L/(g cosθ)) (c) 2π√(L tanθ/g) (d) 2π√(L/(g tanθ))
reason: print drops θ in the text (shown in figure); added
work: T cosθ = mg, T sinθ = mω²L sinθ ⇒ ω² = g/(L cosθ) ⇒ T = 2π√(L cosθ/g)
